pages.text: [#](53341a)The circle must be complete. A gap, even a small one, undoes the whole working — power spills, reagents are wasted, and the rite fails.[#]()
pages.title: Drawing Circles

pages.text: [#](53341a)Place each glyph around the perimeter in the chalk the rite calls for — white for most, **Otherwhere** or **Infernal** where a rite demands it — then set a[#]()
[#](53341a)**Golden** centre in the very middle. Drop the activating ingredient nearby and right-click that golden centre.[#]()
[#](53341a)Whatever the ring, the centre is always gold.[#]()
[#](53341a)**Small** (7x7, 16 glyphs) for infusions, familiar binding, and personal rites.[#]()
pages.title: Three Sizes

pages.text: [#](53341a)**Medium** (11x11, 28 glyphs) for summoning, fertility, and most buff rites.[#]()
[#](53341a)**Large** (15x15, 40 glyphs) for world-altering rites, curses, and dimensional workings.[#]()
[#](53341a)The Circle Talisman stores a pattern and redeploys it instantly.[#]()
